support_claim: Bounded specified profile on canonical fixtures; no executable analysis engine or full CDM certification yet.

request_contract.concept_ids: unique exact nonnegative integers <= 2147483647; 0 only by explicit selection; no descendants or implicit concept expansion
request_contract.window: explicit inclusive ISO dates; start <= end; at most 120 touched calendar months; DATE columns only
request_contract.disclosure_policy_id: nonempty versioned institutional policy ID; synthetic-unsuppressed-v1 is fixture-only

populations.source_context: Exactly one selected source/schema snapshot; never join sources by person ID.
populations.person_table: Accessible PERSON with unique non-null person_id; count all-source people independently of request window.
populations.valid_observation_people: PERSON members with valid inclusive observation intervals. Merge overlap/adjacency per person, then clip to the request window.
populations.observed_measurement_rows: Selected concept/date in inclusive request window, linked to PERSON, whose measurement_date belongs to at least one valid person observation period. Membership never multiplies rows.
populations.requested_outputs: The fixed required_outputs list for one request/run.

temporal_policy.month_key: YYYY-MM-01; period_start/end clipped to request window; partial edge months retained
temporal_policy.calendar: proleptic Gregorian, ISO years 0001..9999; no 1900..2099 fixed calendar

preflight_policy.person_ids: Null/duplicate person IDs fail PERSON-dependent outputs.
preflight_policy.observation_rows: Null endpoints, end<start, or orphan person IDs fail observation-dependent outputs; do not silently drop malformed intervals.
preflight_policy.measurement_rows: Selected in-window null/orphan person IDs fail measurement-dependent outputs; duplicate record IDs do not collapse physical rows.
preflight_policy.concept_rows: Conflicting duplicate concept IDs fail terminology-dependent outputs; no matching positive unit ID is unknown, not a compatible unit.
preflight_policy.access: Missing/inaccessible prerequisites produce unavailable reasons; never replace them with zero.

availability_semantics.precedence: Failed/inaccessible/unsupported prerequisites have no numeric value. Otherwise empty_source context (PERSON count 0) takes precedence over empty_population context (source people exist but a metric-specific eligible set is empty).
availability_semantics.zero: A computed count can be exactly 0 when the relevant observed population exists but no selected event matches.
availability_semantics.numeric_empty: An observed summary stratum with n=0 has empty_population and all statistic fields NULL; an unobserved stratum is not fabricated.
availability_semantics.completeness: Every fixed requested output must be accounted for and validated. Failed/inaccessible/unsupported required computation prevents complete-alpha publication. Known empty results and verified policy-approved suppression can be complete; missing optional metadata remains explicitly unknown.
availability_semantics.wire_contract: Exact status/value serialization and publication contracts are separate; retain these semantic distinctions.

numeric_eligibility.when: operator_concept_id is non-null and not 0; includes equality and all censored/unknown operators
unit_concept_id does not resolve uniquely to a positive Unit-domain concept

precision_policy.exact_count_strings: Arbitrary-precision nonnegative integer strings at interchange; no JavaScript Number coercion.
precision_policy.exact_decimal_strings_and_rational_mean: Finite PostgreSQL NUMERIC values, exact decimal strings for sum/order statistics, rational mean sum/n; no rounding or FLOAT cast. Non-finite values excluded with counts. Standard deviation and interpolated/approximate quantiles excluded.
precision_policy.display: Approximate chart coordinates, if needed, must be labelled and backed by exact table values; no rounded display value may replace metric values.

disclosure_policy.scope: Authorized institutional use only; no automatic distributable export.
disclosure_policy.synthetic: synthetic-unsuppressed-v1 permits only synthetic fixture verification.
disclosure_policy.live: An institutional versioned policy is required. No default small-cell threshold is invented here.
disclosure_policy.suppressed: Hide all numeric payload, counts/extrema/quantiles included, with a policy reason. Retained raw frequency inputs remain restricted scratch, never viewer outputs.
disclosure_policy.guarantee: Suppression is not an anonymity guarantee; provider/bundle wire rules are a separate contract.

dimensions.raw_tag: Tagged null, zero or exact ID; NULL and 0 never conflate. Sparse raw tags use source values, not terminology-driven rewriting.
dimensions.periods: One requested-window row plus every touched calendar month for window_and_month outputs. They are separate grains, not additive partitions of people.

metrics.title: Source and definition identity
metrics.aggregation: Read metadata and supplied immutable identity assertions; retain origin and unknown reasons. Do not infer snapshot identity from max event date.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: Missing metadata is unknown, never an empty string, zero or inferred current release.

metrics.title: Declared dependency capabilities
metrics.aggregation: Probe only the finite dependency list; distinguish absent from inaccessible. Optional feature presence never means clinical analysis support.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: An empty table is present/readable with zero rows; permission denial is inaccessible.

metrics.title: All-source people
metrics.aggregation: COUNT(DISTINCT person_id). Require unique non-null person IDs; fail this prerequisite when ambiguous.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: 0 with empty_source when an accessible PERSON table is empty; missing/inaccessible table has no numeric value.

metrics.title: People with observation in the window
metrics.aggregation: Count each PERSON member whose valid observation union intersects the inclusive request window once.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: 0 with empty_population if no person has observation in the window.

metrics.title: Monthly observed people
metrics.aggregation: Clip merged person intervals to window/month; count a person once if any eligible day remains. Emit every requested month.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: Dense zero rows for months with no observed people; mark empty_population. Never sum monthly people to obtain window people.

metrics.title: Unique observed person-days
metrics.aggregation: Inclusive union of person/date days. Merge overlapping and adjacent intervals, then clip. Count one person-day once.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: 0 with empty_population when the eligible day set is empty.

metrics.title: Eligible measurement records
metrics.aggregation: Count each selected source row once using observation membership, never one row per matching observation period. Preserve physical duplicate rows, even repeated measurement IDs.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: Emit every selected concept × requested period; known empty counts are 0. Empty observation denominator is empty_population; unavailable/failed/suppressed is never numeric 0.

metrics.title: Distinct tested people
metrics.denominator: observation.person_count for window; observation.monthly_person_count for month
metrics.aggregation: Count distinct PERSON members per concept/period. Ratios, if displayed, use that same-period observed-person denominator and are not prevalence estimates.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: Emit every selected concept × requested period; known empty counts are 0. Empty observation denominator is empty_population; unavailable/failed/suppressed is never numeric 0.

metrics.title: Result representation cells
metrics.grain: record in one of eight flag combinations
metrics.aggregation: Numeric-present means value_as_number IS NOT NULL (non-finite values are still present). Coded-present means non-null/nonzero value_as_concept_id, even if unmapped. Source-text-present means value_source_value after trimming U+0020 spaces is nonempty. Emit all 2×2×2 combinations.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: Emit every selected concept × requested period; known empty counts are 0. Empty observation denominator is empty_population; unavailable/failed/suppressed is never numeric 0. Never equate source text with a standardized value.

metrics.title: Unit representation
metrics.aggregation: Sparse counts of each observed raw unit tag. Missing, unmapped, known Unit-domain IDs and unknown/wrong-domain IDs retain distinct labels.
metrics.unit_rule: raw_tag:null_vs_zero_vs_id; never pool or convert units
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: No row means an unobserved unit tag only when the parent output is complete; never infer values for undeclared unit strata.

metrics.title: Operator representation
metrics.aggregation: Sparse counts by exact raw operator. NULL and 0 remain different tags; local terminology supplies labels without changing values.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: No row means an unobserved operator tag only when the parent output is complete.

metrics.title: Numeric inclusion and exclusion reasons
metrics.grain: record in exactly one eligibility category
metrics.aggregation: Apply ordered numeric_eligibility rules once per row. Emit every reason including zero cells; totals reconcile to record_count.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: Emit every selected concept × requested period; known empty counts are 0. Empty observation denominator is empty_population; unavailable/failed/suppressed is never numeric 0.

metrics.title: Exact numeric summary
metrics.grain: numeric record within concept/known unit/raw operator
metrics.denominator: n = eligible finite numeric records in that exact stratum; never people or all observed people
metrics.aggregation: Finite exact NUMERIC values only, in mapped Unit-domain strata with raw operator NULL or 0, kept separate. Preserve frequency weights and duplicate multiplicity. Quantile p is x[ceil(p*n)] in the sorted empirical sample. Mean is exact sum/n, not a binary float.
metrics.unit_rule: known Unit-domain positive concept ID; no conversion; validity date not used to rewrite historical values
metrics.operator_rule: NULL or 0 only, separate raw strata; label no explicit comparator, not proven uncensored; all nonzero operators excluded in this profile
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: Emit a zero-n/empty_population summary for an observed mapped-unit/allowed-operator group with no eligible numeric values; all statistics including sum/mean are NULL. Groups with excluded units/operators are explained by eligibility counts, not fabricated summaries.

metrics.title: Requested output availability
metrics.grain: one status per requested metric and source
metrics.aggregation: Account for every requested output. Complete publication requires all outputs validated or explicitly policy-approved suppressed; zero/empty is not failure. A changed request creates a new recorded request.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: States preserve empty source/population, missing prerequisites, unsupported, inaccessible, not requested, failed, suppressed and stale reasons. Wire schema follows separately.

metrics.title: Measured execution timing
metrics.aggregation: Monotonic wall-clock duration rounded to nearest millisecond, half-up, for declared phases. Driver/warehouse telemetry is optional and not inferred from duration.
metrics.zero_and_null_rule: A measured sub-millisecond duration can be 0; missing telemetry is NULL with an unavailable reason.
